description: Buddy, panel, bubble, and editor windows: the frontend drives everything through app commands (toggle_panel, close_panel, start_buddy_drag, …); window geometry and visibility are managed Rust-side, so no core:window IPC grants are needed. Region selection runs in the overlay window, which likewise drives everything through app commands. The tutorial editor's editor_* session commands are NOT granted here — build.rs's app manifest capability-gates them, and capabilities/editor.json grants them to the editor window alone (Task 11, R8's app-manifest half).
